# DuckDB for Data Engineers: A Practical Guide

DuckDB has quietly become my favourite tool for ad-hoc data analysis.

## What it is

An in-process OLAP database. Think SQLite but column-oriented and optimised for analytical queries.

## Where it shines

```sql
SELECT month, SUM(revenue)
FROM read_parquet('s3://my-bucket/sales/*.parquet')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
```

No cluster to provision. No schema to define. Just run the query.

## Limitations

- Not designed for concurrent writes
- Not a replacement for transactional databases

For read-heavy analytics pipelines, DuckDB is hard to beat.
